description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git reference operations such as creating, updating, deleting, and validating references, as well as testing reflog expiration, symbolic references, and filesystem interaction scenarios within a Git backend testing environment.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up initial commits and references for the test environment.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool rev-parse
methods.description: Verifies that empty directories do not interfere with 'git rev-parse' resolution.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool for-each-ref
methods.description: Ensures that 'git for-each-ref' operates correctly with empty directories.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool create
methods.description: Tests creation of references in directories that may exist within the repository.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool verify
methods.description: Verifies that reference verification ignores empty directories.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool 1-arg update
methods.description: Checks updating a reference with one argument in empty directory scenarios.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool 2-arg update
methods.description: Checks updating a reference with two arguments in empty directory scenarios.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool 0-arg delete
methods.description: Tests deletion of references via zero-argument method in empty directory context.

methods.name: empty directory should not fool 1-arg delete
methods.description: Tests deletion with one argument in empty directory context.

methods.name: non-empty directory blocks create
methods.description: Ensures that creating references in non-empty directories is blocked as expected.

methods.name: broken reference blocks create
methods.description: Verifies that broken references prevent creation or updating.

methods.name: non-empty directory blocks indirect create
methods.description: Checks restrictions on creating references in directories containing symbolic references.

methods.name: broken reference blocks indirect create
methods.description: Ensures broken symbolic references block creation of new references.

methods.name: no bogus intermediate values during delete
methods.description: Ensures no intermediate or inconsistent reference states are visible during deletion processes.

methods.name: delete fails cleanly if packed-refs lock is held
methods.description: Tests proper error handling when packed-refs file is locked during deletion.

methods.name: delete fails cleanly if packed-refs.new write fails
methods.description: Ensures error handling when packing references fails during deletion.

methods.name: setup worktree
methods.description: Sets up a Git worktree environment with separate branch and commits for testing.

methods.name: for_each_reflog()
methods.description: Tests iteration over reflogs within the main repository and worktrees, verifying correct reflog handling.

methods.name: parsing reverse reflogs at BUFSIZ boundaries
methods.description: Tests reflog parsing correctness at buffer boundary conditions.

methods.name: reflog expire operates on symref not referrent
methods.description: Tests that reflog expiration acts on symbolic references, not their referents.

methods.name: empty reflog
methods.description: Verifies that an empty reflog does not produce errors during expiration.

methods.name: ref resolution not confused by broken symlinks
methods.description: Ensures broken symlinks in refs do not cause incorrect resolution.

methods.name: log diagnoses bogus HEAD hash
methods.description: Checks that invalid HEAD hashes generate appropriate error messages.

methods.name: log diagnoses bogus HEAD symref
methods.description: Checks handling of invalid symbolic HEAD references.

methods.name: empty directory removal
methods.description: Verifies proper removal of references and logs when directories are deleted.

methods.name: symref empty directory removal
methods.description: Ensures that symbolic references in directories are cleaned up properly.

methods.name: directory not created deleting packed ref
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to delete references in missing directories fails gracefully.

methods.name: git branch -m u v should fail when the reflog for u is a symlink
methods.description: Tests migration of branch names with symlinks in reflogs, expecting failure.

methods.name: git branch -m with symlinked .git/refs
methods.description: Tests renaming branches in repositories with symlinked reference directories.

methods.name: rebase when .git/logs is a symlink
methods.description: Verifies rebase operation correctness when logs directory is symlinked.

methods.name: git reflog expire honors core.sharedRepository
methods.description: Checks that reflog expiration respects shared repository permissions.

methods.name: symref transaction supports symlinks
methods.description: Tests symbolic ref transactions involving symlinks.

methods.name: symref transaction supports false symlink config
methods.description: Verifies behavior with symbolic ref transactions when configuration disables symlink usage.
